findings.description: No key_policy is specified for the KMS key, meaning it defaults to the AWS-managed default policy granting full IAM-based access to the root account (effectively allowing any IAM principal with kms:* permissions in the account to use/manage the key). For an audit trail key, this violates least privilege since access should be tightly scoped to specific roles that need to encrypt/decrypt audit logs.
The resource does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic key rotation is disabled by default, weakening the long-term cryptographic hygiene of a key protecting sensitive audit trail data.
